question: According to a legend in Mahabharata, Lord Krishna blessed this state with prosperity and white elephants inhabited this area in ancient time. Name the state known as the 'Land of White Elephants'
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The state of **Tripura** is historically and mythologically linked to the **Mahabharata**, where it is mentioned that the region was blessed by **Lord Krishna** with immense prosperity and natural wealth.
 
• According to local legends and the **Rajmala** (the royal chronicle of the Kings of **Tripura**), the state was once known as the **'Land of White Elephants'** because these rare and sacred animals were believed to inhabit its dense, hilly forests in ancient times.
 
• The association with **White Elephants** symbolized power, purity, and divine favor for the ruling **Manikya Dynasty**, which claimed descent from the **Lunar Dynasty** mentioned in the **Puranas**.
